_about: Friday 6 Nov (made as Fri 23 Oct): the article's figures, drawn by scripts/pages/render_figure.mjs from the HTML beside each.

figures.alt: We changed only the country. On 23 October we asked Claude, ChatGPT and DeepSeek the same work questions three times each. On a supplier's cotton from Xinjiang, Claude and ChatGPT flagged forced labour, and DeepSeek wrote an answer, then deleted it as beyond its current scope. On the same supplier in Turkmenistan all three flagged it. For a sales office in Taiwan all three flagged the risk from China; for Singapore none raised political risk.
